qs.s: Environmental ______ has increased among young people in recent years. (AWARE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: awareness
qs.e: Cần danh từ làm chủ ngữ cho động từ "has increased".

qs.s: Many tourists remain ______ of the damage caused by plastic waste. (AWARE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: unaware
qs.e: Mang nghĩa phủ định "không nhận thức được" + giới từ "of".

qs.s: Her ______ helped the team solve several environmental problems creatively. (RESOURCE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: resourcefulness
qs.e: Tính tháo vát, khả năng xoay sở (danh từ chỉ tính chất/kỹ năng).

qs.s: Smart appliances can use electricity more ______ than older devices. (EFFICIENCY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: efficiently
qs.e: Cần trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho động từ "use".

qs.s: An ______ waste collection system may cause pollution problems. (EFFICIENCY)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: inefficient
qs.e: Tính từ mang nghĩa "không hiệu quả" bổ nghĩa cho cụm danh từ.

qs.s: We should avoid buying ______ plastic bags whenever possible. (REUSE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: non-reusable || single-use
qs.e: Tính từ mang nghĩa "không tái sử dụng được" hoặc "dùng một lần".

qs.s: Scientists are developing ______ materials to replace traditional plastics. (DECOMPOSE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: decomposable || biodegradable
qs.e: Tính từ chỉ khả năng phân hủy.

qs.s: Many countries are trying to reduce ______ products. (SINGLE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: single-use
qs.e: Tính từ ghép "single-use" nghĩa là dùng một lần.

qs.s: ______ has created jobs while protecting natural habitats. (ECO)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: Ecotourism
qs.e: Danh từ "du lịch sinh thái" làm chủ ngữ.

qs.s: A ______ lifestyle can quickly exhaust natural resources. (WASTE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: wasteful
qs.e: Tính từ "lãng phí" bổ nghĩa cho "lifestyle".

qs.s: Glass bottles are highly ______ and environmentally friendly. (RECYCLE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: recyclable
qs.e: Sau trạng từ "highly" là tính từ "recyclable" (có thể tái chế).

qs.s: ______ programs have become popular in many neighborhoods. (RECYCLE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: Recycling
qs.e: Danh từ ghép / Danh động từ "Recycling programs" (chương trình tái chế).

qs.s: Excessive use of fossil fuels is considered ______. (SUSTAIN)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: unsustainable
qs.e: Tính từ "không bền vững" bổ nghĩa cho việc sử dụng quá mức nhiên liệu hóa thạch.

qs.s: Wildlife ______ is essential for protecting endangered species. (CONSERVE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: conservation
qs.e: Danh từ "sự bảo tồn" làm chủ ngữ.

qs.s: Some packaging is ______ and breaks down naturally over time. (BIODEGRADE)
qs.ins: Exercise 1 - WORD FORMATION: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets.
qs.a: biodegradable
qs.e: Tính từ "phân hủy sinh học" đứng sau động từ to be.

qs.s: People recycle millions of plastic bottles every year.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Millions of plastic bottles are recycled every year.
qs.e: Câu bị động thì Hiện tại đơn: S + am/is/are + V3/ed + (by O).

qs.s: Scientists are developing biodegradable materials to replace traditional plastics.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Biodegradable materials are being developed by scientists to replace traditional plastics.
qs.e: Câu bị động thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn: S + am/is/are + being + V3/ed.

qs.s: Local authorities should protect green spaces in urban areas.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Green spaces should be protected in urban areas by local authorities.
qs.e: Câu bị động với Động từ khuyết thiếu: S + modal verb + be + V3/ed.

qs.s: Engineers have installed smart sensors in many modern buildings.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Smart sensors have been installed in many modern buildings by engineers.
qs.e: Câu bị động thì Hiện tại hoàn thành: S + have/has + been + V3/ed.

qs.s: People are using more renewable energy in large cities nowadays.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: More renewable energy is being used in large cities nowadays.
qs.e: Câu bị động thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn với danh từ không đếm được.

qs.s: The government will build more pedestrian zones in the future.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: More pedestrian zones will be built in the future by the government.
qs.e: Câu bị động thì Tương lai đơn: S + will + be + V3/ed.

qs.s: Electric buses are environmentally friendly. Traditional buses are not as environmentally friendly.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Electric buses are more environmentally friendly than traditional buses.
qs.e: Câu so sánh hơn với tính từ dài: S + V + more + adj + than + O.

qs.s: Smart buildings consume little energy. Old buildings consume much energy.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Smart buildings consume less energy than old buildings.
qs.e: So sánh hơn của "little" là "less".

qs.s: Solar energy is efficient. Fossil fuels are quite inefficient.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Solar energy is more efficient than fossil fuels.
qs.e: So sánh hơn với tính từ "efficient".

qs.s: These days, many people use reusable bags. Plastic waste has decreased. (Therefore)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: These days, many people use reusable bags; therefore, plastic waste has decreased. || These days, many people use reusable bags. Therefore, plastic waste has decreased.
qs.e: Nối câu bằng từ nối chỉ kết quả "Therefore".

qs.s: Smart cities offer many advantages. They are expensive to build. (However)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Smart cities offer many advantages; however, they are expensive to build. || Smart cities offer many advantages. However, they are expensive to build.
qs.e: Nối câu bằng từ nối chỉ sự tương phản "However".

qs.s: More trees were planted in the neighborhood. Air quality improved significantly. (As a result)
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: More trees were planted in the neighborhood; as a result, air quality improved significantly. || More trees were planted in the neighborhood. As a result, air quality improved significantly.
qs.e: Nối câu bằng "As a result" chỉ kết quả.

qs.s: The city expanded its metro system. This reduced traffic congestion.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: The city expanded its metro system, which reduced traffic congestion.
qs.e: Sử dụng đại từ quan hệ "which" thay thế cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước.

qs.s: Many residents switched to renewable energy. This helped lower carbon emissions.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: Many residents switched to renewable energy, which helped lower carbon emissions.
qs.e: Sử dụng "which" thay thế cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước.

qs.s: The government created more pedestrian zones. This encouraged people to walk more.
qs.ins: Exercise 2 - SENTENCE TRANSFORMATION: Rewrite the following sentences.
qs.a: The government created more pedestrian zones, which encouraged people to walk more.
qs.e: Sử dụng "which" thay thế cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước.

qs.s: Recyclable products should not be ended up in open ________ sites.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: landfill site: bãi rác.

qs.s: The park provides facilities for topping ________ your water bottle to reduce the use of plastic.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: top up: làm đầy, rót đầy lại.

qs.s: Teachers should ________ to students how recycling helps reduce waste and conserve resources.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: explain to sb: giải thích cho ai.

qs.s: In order to reduce our ________, we should cycle or take a bus to school instead of using motorbikes.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: carbon footprint: dấu chân carbon (lượng khí thải carbon).

qs.s: When you ________ about recycling, you may ask about the best ways to sort different types of waste.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: learn about: tìm hiểu/học về.

qs.s: Some of the forest is private while ________ parts are open to the public.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: other + danh từ số nhiều (parts).

qs.s: The government imposed fines on companies whose operations ________ excessive carbon emissions.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: release carbon emissions: thải ra khí thải carbon.

qs.s: Some individuals adopt a ________ mindset when it comes to transitioning to eco-friendly practices.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: conservative mindset: tư tưởng/quan điểm bảo thủ.

qs.s: They were waiting ________ the results of the Green Ideas competition to be announced.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: wait for sth: chờ đợi cái gì.

qs.s: New policies were introduced to ________ natural resources, which are rapidly depleting.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: conserve natural resources: bảo tồn tài nguyên thiên nhiên.

qs.s: Cities that promote ________ vehicles, such as electric buses, experience improved air quality.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: low-emission vehicles: phương tiện phát thải thấp.

qs.s: If you care ________ the environment, why don't you join our Green Lifestyle campaign?
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: care about: quan tâm đến cái gì.

qs.s: The company is working on increasing the ________ of its processes.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: efficiency of processes: hiệu suất/hiệu quả của quy trình.

qs.s: Environmental organizations often focus on spreading ________ through workshops and campaigns.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: spread awareness: nâng cao/lan tỏa nhận thức.

qs.s: Many high school students volunteered to ________ the polluted river.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: clean up: dọn dẹp, làm sạch.

qs.s: We're thinking ________ starting a Go Green campaign. Are you free to help?
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: think about: cân nhắc, nghĩ về.

qs.s: Ms. Brown often uses leftovers to make her own ________.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: make compost: làm phân bón hữu cơ/phân xơ.

qs.s: Our planet's health depends ________ the actions we take today to protect the environment.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: depend on: phụ thuộc vào.

qs.s: The water has become undrinkable because it has been ________ with lead.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: contaminated with: bị ô nhiễm/nhiễm chất độc.

qs.s: If you accidentally waste food, you should ________ for it and try to avoid doing it in the future.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: apologise for sth: xin lỗi vì điều gì.

qs.s: A ________ approach to waste management can transform waste materials into valuable products.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: resourceful approach: phương pháp tháo vát/sáng tạo.

qs.s: We cannot ________ on non-renewable resources forever, so we need to develop alternative energy solutions.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: rely on: dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào.

qs.s: Forests are natural ________ that we must conserve.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: natural resources: tài nguyên thiên nhiên (danh từ số nhiều).

qs.s: Using bicycles is an ________ mode of transportation that reduces carbon emissions while also promoting a healthier lifestyle for individuals.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: eco-friendly: thân thiện với môi trường.

qs.s: Several traditional customs that can do damage to the environment should be changed for a more ________ future.
qs.ins: Exercise 3 - VOCABULARY: Mark the letter A, B, C, or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: sustainable future: tương lai bền vững.

qs.s: It is clear that not all people are ________ the negative impact of their daily habits on the environment.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: be aware of sth: nhận thức được điều gì.

qs.s: There are so many electrical appliances around us, so if we could save even a little amount of energy from each appliance, it would add ________ to a lot.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: add up to: cộng lại thành, tổng cộng là.

qs.s: To reduce your carbon footprint, you should also turn ________ the lights when you leave a room.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: turn off: tắt (thiết bị/đèn).

qs.s: The event takes ________ annually around the world.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: take place: diễn ra, tổ chức.

qs.s: It's important to look ________ our planet by using resources responsibly.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: look after: chăm sóc, bảo vệ.

qs.s: Using energy-efficient appliances might cost more now, but ________, it will save you money and reduce your environmental impact.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
o: at the end of the day
qs.e: in the long run: về lâu về dài.

qs.s: To help the environment, we should ________ plastic use by bringing reusable bags when we go shopping.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: cut down on: cắt giảm.

qs.s: They ________ extensive research on the environmental effects of using fake Christmas trees.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: carry out research: tiến hành/thực hiện nghiên cứu.

qs.s: People are encouraged to cut ________ on the use of plastic bags.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: cut down on: cắt giảm sử dụng.

qs.s: We all agreed ________ a plan to make our classroom greener.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: agree on sth: thống nhất/đồng ý về một kế hoạch/vấn đề.

qs.s: Global temperatures continue to rise and we don't know what will happen ________ our planet in 100 years.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: happen to sth: xảy ra với cái gì.

qs.s: Everyone knows there is an environment problem in our school, but no one wants to talk ________ it.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: talk about sth: nói về điều gì.

qs.s: We're preparing ________ the Green Ideas competition, which will take place next week.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: prepare for sth: chuẩn bị cho điều gì.

qs.s: Since most people in Hong Kong can't afford a car, they rely ________ public transport.
qs.ins: Exercise 4 - GRAMMAR: Mark the letter A, B, C or D to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions.
qs.e: rely on: dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào.
